Class AnahataFileIconProvider

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.ui.AnahataFileIconProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.intellij.ide.FileIconProvider
public class AnahataFileIconProvider extends Object implements com.intellij.ide.FileIconProvider
Provides a branded Anahata logo icon for anahata.md files in IntelliJ IDEA.

Ensures anahata.md files stand out visually in the Project view, editor tabs, and navigation bars without altering or injecting synthetic tree nodes.

anahata
